record.title: Falsify the complete synthetic version and DDR consumer region in stock Sparrow
record.intent: Test software state propagation to the calibration boundary under the fixed synthetic fixture.
requirements: Require complete private controls and the same executable; preserve APK and library byte-for-byte in one fresh disposable guest.
Validate the 464-store prefix then exactly ten new read responses two predicted stores and three checkpoints; do not adapt on mismatch.
Independently verify versions tap output order masks self-test result live configuration shadow state and unexecuted terminal PC before calibration.
Keep thread coverage and cleanup evidence explicit; no process-wide atomic snapshot or physical DDR clock or acquisition claim; preserve system_server enforcement and stop guest services.
acceptance: Commit and push the reproducible conclusion before successor execution.
